tasks.title: Phone layout recorder for Website Audit Sample Pages
tasks.description: Add `packages/core/src/audit/phone-layout.ts` exporting `recordPhoneLayout(page, opts)` that produces the `PhoneLayout` contract (`packages/types/src/website-audit.ts:549`, Q-28: phone-width screenshot plus the existing overflow and tap-target findings). It sets the page to the existing 375px breakpoint (`BREAKPOINT_VIEWPORTS['375px']` in `packages/core/src/browser.ts`), waits for layout, saves a full-page screenshot under the version folder given in `opts` and returns its path relative to that folder (null when the screenshot fails), measures horizontal overflow (`overflow: true|false`, null when not checked), and runs the existing `UXQualityChecker` rules at `breakpoint: '375px'` to collect the tap-target and overflow findings, returning them with `findingIds`. It restores the previous viewport. It makes no network request of its own (works on the page the audit pipeline already loaded). It is not wired into the audit pipeline here: the per-page pipeline task (G3) calls it for Sample Pages and sets `AuditPage.phone`. Not exported from the core barrel (owned by G1 BE-190); the pipeline imports it by path. The test uses Chromium with `page.setContent` pages (one that overflows at 375px with a 20x20 px button, one that fits) so it needs no server and no network.
acceptance_criteria: Given a page wider than 375px at phone width with a small tap target, when `recordPhoneLayout` runs, then it returns `widthPx: 375`, `overflow: true`, a screenshot path relative to the version folder whose file exists and is a PNG 375px wide, and `findingIds` naming the overflow and tap-target findings it returns (REQ-037 AC-1).
Given a page that fits the phone width, when recorded, then `overflow` is false and no overflow finding is returned.
Given the screenshot fails (closed page or unwritable folder), when recorded, then `screenshotPath` is null and the function does not throw.
Given the recorder, when it ran, then the page's previous viewport is restored and no request other than the page's own was made.
Given finding wording, when read, then it follows ADR 0018 ('found'/'not found'; no 'passes', 'compliant' or 'accessible').

tasks.title: Integrate new browser tests and config names; whole suite and typecheck pass
tasks.description: Final integration for the test gates. (1) Add every new test file that launches Chromium or a runner to `BROWSER_TESTS` in `vitest.workspace.ts`: from this group `core: audit-phone-layout, audit-languages-e2e` and `wizard: audit-languages-browser`, plus each file the other groups' reports list (G1 QA-195 and the G2..G6 browser tests); confirm with `--project unit` and an empty `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` that no unit file launches Chromium (the method in the workspace comment). (2) Run the four browser shards (CHK-BROWSER-1..4, Q-52) and, if a shard nears its 30-minute limit, tune `vitest.config.ts` (workers, per-project pool) with a stated reason; never skip a file. (3) Add to `.env.example` and `docs/CONFIGURATION.md` every environment variable name other groups' tasks started reading (their handoffs list them; names only, commented out, optional or required as documented), so config-docs.test.ts and CHK-UNIT pass. (4) Run CHK-TYPECHECK and fix nothing outside ownership: report any new error with its owning task. Root cause of every remaining failure goes in the report.
acceptance_criteria: Given every new browser test file from all groups, when `vitest.workspace.ts` is read, then each is in `BROWSER_TESTS`, and a `--project unit` run with an empty `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` launches no Chromium.
Given the developer's PC, when CHK-BROWSER-1..4 run, then each shard finishes within its 30-minute limit, none ends `timed_out`, and every test in the browser project passes (REQ-053 AC-1, AC-2).
Given the developer's PC and the repository in its current folder, when CHK-UNIT and the browser shards run (together `pnpm test`), then every test passes (REQ-046 AC-1).
Given the repository, when `pnpm typecheck` runs, then it exits 0 with no TS errors (REQ-051 AC-1).
Given `.env.example`, when config-docs.test.ts runs, then every name the code reads, `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` included, is listed once and documented (REQ-052).

Given the whole diff of QA-700..QA-713, when reviewed, then no test was deleted or skipped, no assertion weakened, and every raised timeout names its reason (REQ-046 AC-2, REQ-051 AC-2, REQ-053 AC-3).
tasks.validation_waiver: CI cannot run locally and `.github/**` is outside scope: after the PR is opened the developer confirms that ci.yml's 4-shard tests.yml run still passes (REQ-046 AC-3, REQ-053 AC-4). The no-weakening diff review (REQ-046 AC-2, REQ-051 AC-2, REQ-053 AC-3) is done by the code reviewer reading the diff of QA-700..QA-713.
expected_outputs: shard timings per CHK-BROWSER-n in the report
.env.example and docs/CONFIGURATION.md in step with the code
risks: Its full-suite checks fail on any unfinished task's tests; the orchestrator adds every task that adds a browser test or env name to depends_on.
Shares .env.example and docs/CONFIGURATION.md with BE-704 (ordered by the dependency).
